summary: Build practical HR policy and employee relations skills with templates, workflows, and a modernization roadmap. Enrol your team today.
lede: Employee relations training helps HR professionals update workplace policies and handle employee cases consistently. Practical exercises cover policy-gap analysis, review and version-control processes, grievance escalation and disciplinary workflows, manager guidance, and measures for tracking case patterns and resolution, giving HR teams usable procedures for day-to-day practice.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is built for HR professionals who manage policy updates, employee relations cases, and manager guidance in live organizational settings.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of HR operations, employee relations cases, and workplace policy administration. Prior exposure to grievance handling, disciplinary processes, or HR compliance reviews will help you get more from the practical exercises. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable reading policy documents, case logs, and HR dashboards. This is an intermediate course, so you are expected to already understand core HR terminology and basic employee relations procedures. Laptop access is recommended for policy mapping, document drafting, and digital template work. Advanced policy engineering is covered at an operational level, not at a legal drafting or litigation-specialist level.
